title: Example 05: Expose capabilities
summary: One business page has three working views: the Todo itself, a protocol inspector, and a public Surface. Codex, Claude, Hermes Agent, or WorkBuddy connects over HTTPS MCP while records, approvals, and business handlers stay in the page.

guide.title: Connect a real external agent to the page
guide.titleZh: 把一个真实的外部 Agent 接到页面上
intro: This example answers one question: how can a user's own Codex, Claude, Hermes Agent, or WorkBuddy operate a business page without receiving its DOM or internal store?

On the hosted page, ?mcp=1 creates a page session with the official Surface Gateway and shows four client setup tabs. The page keeps the Todo, a protocol inspector, and the public Surface side by side; there is no page chat assistant in this example.

The gateway only transports describe and invoke. The page still validates input, runs the existing business function, and asks its operator to confirm destructive work. A loopback bridge remains in the source for local development.
introZh: 这个案例回答一个问题：用户自己的 Codex、Claude、Hermes Agent 或 WorkBuddy，如何在不拿 DOM、内部 store 的情况下操作同一个业务页面？
打开线上页面并带上 ?mcp=1，页面会向官方 Surface Gateway 申请页面会话，并排展示 Todo、协议检查器与公网 Surface。公网 Surface 提供四个客户端标签页；这个案例不再挂页面聊天助手。
网关只传输 describe 与 invoke；参数校验、业务处理与破坏性操作的真人确认仍由页面完成。源码里保留了本地回环桥，供本地开发和传输层排查使用。

steps.title: Let the adapter own the browser lifecycle
steps.titleZh: 让适配器托管浏览器生命周期
steps.body: The hosted path calls useSurfaceGateway() with an explicit capability allowlist. The adapter creates the page session, WebSocket transport, request bridge, claim, reconnect, and teardown; the demo does not reimplement them.
steps.bodyZh: 公网路径用 useSurfaceGateway() 并传入显式能力清单。页面会话、WebSocket 传输、请求桥、申领、重连与清理都由适配器完成，案例不再重复实现。

steps.title: Ask for a public demo session
steps.titleZh: 申请公开案例页面会话
steps.body: public-demo mode calls a public endpoint bound to the page Origin. The browser receives a page token with a 24-hour maximum, never the admin token.
steps.bodyZh: public-demo 模式调用一个绑定页面 Origin 的公开端点。浏览器拿到最长 24 小时的页面 token，永远拿不到 admin token。

steps.title: Create an Agent session from the page
steps.titleZh: 由页面创建 Agent 会话
steps.body: After the page WebSocket connects, the page claims an Agent session bound to this browser tab. The public case gives both the page session and Agent token a maximum lifetime of 24 hours and intentionally shows the token so setup stays copyable.
steps.bodyZh: 页面 WebSocket 连上后，会申领一个只绑定当前浏览器标签页的 Agent 会话。公开案例把页面会话与 Agent token 的最长有效期都设为 24 小时，并刻意展示 token，让接入保持可复制。

steps.title: Pass the allowlist, not the DOM
steps.body: The adapter and the local inspector share the same registry and the same six-id allowlist. The gateway still forwards opaque describe and invoke envelopes; approval remains on the page.
steps.bodyZh: 适配器与本地检查器共用同一个 registry 和同一份六项能力清单。网关仍然只转发不透明的 describe 与 invoke 信封，审批仍留在页面。

steps.title: Reuse the executor instead of writing a second one
steps.titleZh: 复用执行器，而不是另写一套执行逻辑
steps.body: The protocol inspector and loopback bridge call the existing executor; the gateway adapter builds its Surface over the same registry. Parameter checks, confirmations, expectations, and audit events therefore stay on one declaration path.
steps.bodyZh: 协议检查器与本地回环桥调用现有执行器；公网适配器也在同一个 registry 上构建 Surface。参数校验、确认、成功判据与审计事件因此仍走同一条声明路径。

steps.title: Write down the external allowlist
steps.titleZh: 明确写出对外允许清单
steps.body: Only these six capability ids are visible and callable. Everything else remains a page-internal action.
steps.bodyZh: 只有这六项能力可见、可调用；其余动作仍只属于页面内部。

steps.title: Describe business effects and parameters
steps.body: Each capability has a stable id, a description, typed parameters, and an effect. Deletion is marked danger and always requires confirmation.
steps.bodyZh: 每项能力都有稳定 id、说明、类型化参数与效果。删除标记为 danger，并且每次都要求确认。

steps.title: Publish records, not component internals
steps.titleZh: 发布记录，而不是组件内部结构
steps.body: v-record supplies stable ids and readable fields. The external client can choose a record without receiving the component's reactive state.
steps.bodyZh: v-record 提供稳定 id 与可读字段。外部客户端可以选择记录，但不会收到组件的响应式状态。

steps.title: Keep a loopback bridge for local development
steps.titleZh: 保留本地回环桥用于开发
steps.body: When the page runs on localhost, ?mcp=1 can use the loopback bridge instead. Browsers block a public HTTPS page from reaching a private loopback socket, which is why the hosted page uses the gateway.
steps.bodyZh: 页面在 localhost 运行时，?mcp=1 可以使用本地回环桥。浏览器会拦截公网 HTTPS 页面访问私有回环端口，所以线上页面必须走网关。

steps.title: Expose those methods as MCP tools
steps.titleZh: 把这两个方法映射成 MCP 工具
steps.body: The stdio server exposes describe, invoke, and a read-only approval-status query. There is deliberately no tool that approves on the user's behalf.
steps.bodyZh: stdio server 暴露 describe、invoke 与只读的审批状态查询。它刻意没有“代用户批准”的工具。

steps.title: Offer a client-specific setup tab
steps.titleZh: 为每个客户端提供独立标签页
steps.body: Codex and Claude get copyable CLI commands; Hermes Agent and WorkBuddy get remote-MCP settings plus a generic mcpServers JSON block. Every path points at the same HTTPS endpoint and keeps the token outside tool arguments.
steps.bodyZh: Codex 与 Claude 得到可复制的 CLI 命令；Hermes Agent 与 WorkBuddy 得到远程 MCP 设置和通用 mcpServers JSON。所有路径都指向同一个 HTTPS 端点，token 也不会变成工具参数。

steps.title: Keep destructive approval on the page
steps.titleZh: 把破坏性审批留在页面
steps.body: An external request cannot approve itself. The page operator sees the pending action, and only their decision releases the promise.
steps.bodyZh: 外部请求不能自我批准。页面操作者看到待处理动作，只有其决定才会释放执行。

guide.note: Open https://plingjs.dev/demos/external-agent-surface/?mcp=1&lang=zh, choose Codex, Claude, Hermes Agent, or WorkBuddy, and copy that tab's setup. Keep the page open. A page session lasts at most 24 hours; reloading creates a new token, and one page binds one Agent, so multiple Agents need separate pages. Deletion returns pending_approval and waits for the person on the page. The direct token is a public-demo convenience; production integrations should use OAuth or device authorization. The local stdio bridge remains in the source for development only.
guide.noteZh: 打开 https://plingjs.dev/demos/external-agent-surface/?mcp=1&lang=zh，选择 Codex、Claude、Hermes Agent 或 WorkBuddy，复制对应标签页的接入片段。页面要保持打开。页面会话最长 24 小时；刷新会生成新 token，一个页面只绑定一个 Agent，多 Agent 请分别新开页面。删除会返回 pending_approval，并在本页等待真人确认。直接展示 token 是公开案例的便捷模式；生产环境应使用 OAuth 或设备授权。本地 stdio 桥只保留用于开发。
